description: Implementation of UDP network gateway including socket creation, binding, sending, receiving, and configuration.

classes.name: receive_context
classes.description: Context structure for receiving UDP packets using recvmmsg, managing buffers and message headers.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::udp_network_gateway_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UDP network gateway with configuration, data notifier, and executors.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::subscribe_to
methods.description: Registers the UDP socket with an IO broker for asynchronous receive operations.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles outgoing PDU by batching and preparing for transmission.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Processes batched PDUs, constructs msghdrs, and sends via sendmmsg.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::handle_io_error
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during IO operations.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::create_and_bind
methods.description: Creates and binds UDP socket to specified address and port, with options for reuse and non-blocking mode.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::receive
methods.description: Receives UDP packets using recvmmsg, handles buffer pool occupancy, and forwards PDUs.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::get_bind_port
methods.description: Retrieves the port number the socket is bound to.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::get_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address the socket is bound to.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_sockopts
methods.description: Sets socket options such as receive timeout and DSCP.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_non_blocking
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_dscp
methods.description: Sets DSCP value on socket for QoS.
